corrections.was: Third, do different enemies or options call for different answers? That is unit differentiation, and it is what makes a situational choice possible.
corrections.now: Third, do different enemies or options call for different answers? That is unit differentiation, and it is one thing that makes a situational choice possible.
corrections.why: Saying unit differentiation is what makes situational choice possible presents it as the only cause; the source defines situational choice as any choice whose value depends on the situation, and slide 3 step 2 shows one (the same UFO, three situations of score, lives and invader distance) with no differentiated enemies.

unresolved: slide 3 step 1: the narration calls the invader and UFO points (10 to 30, 50 to 150, 300 on the 23rd shot) a made-up example, following the Illustrative data badge, but the source notes give the UFO as worth 50 to 300 points from the source video; whether these values are illustrative or real is for the deck author to settle (the writer also flagged it).
